secrets.name: AI_INTEGRATIONS_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
secrets.description: Anthropic API key for the AI-powered writing/analysis features. The app UI boots without it; AI endpoints fail until it is set. NOTE: the code uses Replit's aliased model names (claude-haiku-4-5, claude-sonnet-4-6), so a plain Anthropic key + api.anthropic.com base URL may need matching model aliases to work.

secrets.name: AI_INTEGRATIONS_ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL
secrets.description: Base URL for the Anthropic-compatible API (e.g. https://api.anthropic.com, or a Replit AI integrations proxy URL). Optional but recommended alongside the API key.
